title: Mountain Moment: Narada Falls
place: Narada Falls, along the road to Paradise, Mount Rainier National Park, Washington
audio: natural ('Audio of rushing water only', quiet, mean -37 dB)
notes: Two shots: 0-7.0 s = slow tilt/hold on the whole falls fanning down a dark rock face with fir forest and blue sky above (falls x~0.45-0.6); hard cut at 7.06 s to 7.0-14 s = closer frontal view of the wide veil of white streams over black rock (fills x 0.15-0.95, centre ~0.55). Best: 1-6 s and 8-13 s. Sunny 1080p. No people, no text, no logos in the cut (source opens with an NPS arrowhead logo card at 0-~2 s and later has a rainbow-in-mist shot at ~41-49 s if a rainbow cut is wanted).
fact_en: At the end of the short trail, the entire 168-foot-high waterfall is visible. (NPS Narada Falls page; another NPS tour page gives 188 feet in total, so heights vary.)
